releaseNotes:
Feature: Telegram terminal shows this project's preset buttons; a trusted command runs on the open SSH session, and a build that restarts systemd is split so the session stays up
Feature: Telegram accepts zip and pdf files and hands them to the agent
Fix: Settings opens again (invalid Terminal24 icon no longer crashes the page)
